verdicts.title: On Hawaiian Groups of Some Topological Spaces
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: The paper is devoted to study the structure of Hawaiian groups of some topological spaces. We present some behaviors of Hawaiian groups with respect to product spaces, weak join spaces, cone spaces, covering spaces and locally trivial bundles. In particular, we determine the structure of the $n$-dimensional Hawaiian group of the $m$-dimensional Hawaiian earring space, for all $1\leq m\leq n$.
verdicts.judge_reasoning: The abstract concerns Hawaiian groups of topological spaces (products, cones, covering spaces, Hawaiian earrings) and makes no mention of boolean circuits, circuit depth, Tseitin formulas, or local index — it shares no specific claim with the conjecture.

verdicts.title: Cardinal-indexed classifying spaces for families of subgroups of any topological group
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: For $G$ a topological group, existence theorems by Milnor (1956), Gelfand-Fuks (1968), and Segal (1975) of classifying spaces for principal $G$-bundles are generalized to $G$-spaces with torsion. verdicts.title: Local duality in algebra and topology
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: The first goal of this paper is to provide an abstract framework in which to formulate and study local duality in various algebraic and topological contexts.
